Due to 35 or more red points, a follow-up inspection will be conducted for the red item violations noted in this inspection report. A fee of $240 will be assessed by mail for all follow-up inspections. If repeated red item violations are observed at a follow-up inspection, an additional follow-up inspection will be required. Compliance Schedule OBSERVATIONS AND CORRECTIVE ACTIONS You must complete the following items by the due date listed below . Your inspector will do a compliance inspection . If these items are not corrected, you will be billed for the inspection. Violations cited must be corrected within the time frames specified . Complete ByItem Number 10/22/2026 1900 No room temperature storage; proper use of time as a control. 1900 Observed the following: 2 door Avantco prep cooler :(top) hard boiled eggs 60F, vegetable broth 57F, pork broth 61F. Per PIC all items were placed in the top of the prep cooler within the last 2 hours from the walk in cooler. Per PIC the prep cooler is broken and they are awaiting repairs. PIC stated cooler was broken before food was stocked in the prep top cooler. No food was stocked in the bottom of the prep cooler. Room temperature storage of Time /Temperature Control for Safety Food (TCS) is not permitted. Hot hold at 135°F or higher or cold hold at 41°F or below. All items relocated to the walk in cooler, 2" uncovered to cool. Removed non-TCS scallions from nearby 2-door work top cooler to stock broths usually stored in the prep top cooler. *You have had this violation 2 times in the last 2 inspections. We will make a risk control plan if it is found again . **A compliance order to repair or replace the 2-door Avantco prep top cooler by 10/22/2026 has been issued. Failure to comply will result in a $240 fee for non-compliance. Contact your inspector with questions or if you need more time to complete these items.
